title: ORBERA365 Post-Marketing Clinical Follow-up Study
brief_summary: A prospective, multicenter, open-label, post-approval study of the safety and effectiveness of ORBERA36 as a 12-month adjunct to weight reduction for obese adults (BMI ≥ 27 kg/m2 and BMI ≤ 50 kg/m2) or for pre-surgical weight reduction in obese and super-obese adults (BMI ≥ 40 kg/m2 or ≥ 35 kg/m2 with comorbidities).
study_population: Obese adults who had already consented to receive ORBERA365 and who meet the eligibility criteria for the study.
